Bull.story: Unsupervised robotaxi in 50+ metros with disclosed per-mile economics; FSD and robotaxi revenue about $65B; storage compounds 28% a year; auto margin rebuilds to 9%. Half the CEO award's tranches vest (2% a year dilution). 50× a business still growing over 20%.

Base.story: Autonomy real but regional: about 300K robotaxis and 5M FSD subscribers make about $23B of revenue at 50%; storage 20% a year; auto margin back to 6.5%. The premium persists because the story keeps growing: 50×.

Bear.story: Camera-only autonomy stays geofenced and supervised in most places; BYD holds price in Europe and Asia; auto margin recovers only to 5% as capex ends. A car-and-storage company with a brand premium: 27×.

optionality.name: Optimus at scale
optionality.story: a million-plus humanoid robots a year by 2031; possible, not plausible, given Musk's own warning that the ramp starts flat and long

optionality.name: SpaceX merger premium
optionality.story: about a 6% gain for Tesla holders if the deal closes on PW terms (see the merger chapter)
